description: Read Pinnacle pregame prices (international book, not US-licensed): moneyline, spread, total, team total and specials (player props, futures and other Pinnacle specials with their native category) for NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NCAAB, NHL, EPL, MLS, UCL and Bundesliga. Available to every key. Read through at request time (reused up to 20 seconds); no Pinnacle history is stored.
name: get_pinnacle_markets
